reason: Changes the public IContentsTaxonomyListQueryService interface signature (PagerSlim to Pager) and swaps TermPart's pager/shape from PagerSlim to full Pager, which is a breaking API and rendering change for any site/module that customized the TermPart view, injected IContentsTaxonomyListFilter, or relied on the old cursor-based (before/after) pagination behavior on public-facing taxonomy term pages
